text:
maria: Running the long-context synthetic suite today and saw steady memory growth in KV cache for interleaved-prefix workloads. repro attached below.
ryan: oof, is this the prefix-reuse case or the fragmentation one?
sophie: can you paste the failing command?
maria: prefix-reuse-ish. test harness generates many short-lived segments that later get hot again. command:
```
./bench_kv --workload=interleave_prefix --threads=8 --seqlen=32768 --duration=1200 --kv-mode=spillable
```
alan: any flamegraphs / heap profiles?
maria: yes — heap profile at 10m and 20m. difference shows ~2.9GB of retained memory in slab buckets that should be reused.
perf-bot: [perf-bot] Synthetic run 1880005429 finished. avg-rss=8.2GB peak=9.1GB tokens/sec=18k
ryan: can you drop the small repro? quick script to reproduce locally?
maria: minimal repro gist:
```
for i in {1..500}; do 
  python gen_prefix.py --uniq $((i%50)) --length 1024 --emit 100
  sleep 0.02
done
```
This pattern churns fragments and brings old KV entries back into use.
sophie: hypothesis: eviction map keeps tombstones or free lists aren't coalescing, so reuse fails and slabs fragment.
alan: also check the allocator path for different size-classes. I remember a similar issue where multi-slab free lists were per-thread so reuse missed across worker threads.
maria: yeah, we measured per-worker free-lists: reuse_rate worker-3=0.12 worker-4=0.09 while initial runs had ~0.7.
ryan: any quick mitigation we can try in CI? maybe force periodic compaction or a background page reclaimer.
maria: tried periodic compact every 60s (dev flag) — reduces growth but spikes CPU and latency. not great.
perf-bot: [perf-bot] regression_timeline: last-green=1879500000, first-bad=1880002000
sophie: we should add a targeted regression test: interleaved-prefix with long retention and cross-thread reuse, run in nightly with leak-detect.
alan: agreed. test spec: 30m run, 8 threads, seqlen 32k, reuse window 50k tokens, check rss delta < 100MB over last 10m.
maria: I'll add the harness under eng-runtime/perf/harnesses and include flamegraph upload hooks. also adding a short unit that exercises free-list cross-thread handoff.
ryan: please include config that toggles per-thread freelist so we can A/B in CI.
sophie: also record KV hit/miss histogram, eviction_count, compaction_runs in telemetry so we can triage automatically.
maria: noted. one more note: kernel selection/batching interplay matters — when the runtime shifts to small-batch kernels, we see different allocation patterns. will include those knobs in the regtest matrix.
alan: sgtm. assign to maria and add me + ryan as reviewers.
maria: assigning now. will open PR with test + perf-bot gating. :thumbsup:
ryan: thanks — want to see a repro and CI green before we roll that into canary.
